text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ――Well, now that I've finished taking care of my business.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head over to
"An Athlete Family's Cooking Class"?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Guided by Cesario, we arrived at a corner of the Umamusume training club where her mother works as an instructor.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Dad
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Sea-chan and Trainer!
Make sure to have fun today!
choice_data_list: I'm not a member, but can I still join?

text_block_list.name: Training Club Mom
text_block_list.text: "You're more than welcome♪ Shi-chan was practically glued to her mama, too. Right?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Geez. That's in the past, isn't it?
...Trainer, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—I see, so today's theme is
‘An Athlete's Bento for My Child,’ is it?”

text_block_list.name: Training Club Mom
text_block_list.text:
You girls can just use your imagination, Sea-chan!
Like, "What would you make if you were cooking for someone in the future?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's for the child we're guiding together... isn't it?
Let's make a bento packed with nutrition!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Leaving how the bento looks for later,
the ratio of carbs to protein should be—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all done♪
As for the others—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah!
Pre-Fie and Carrotman...
These are all such wonderful character bentos♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Sprint Umamusume dads get extra carbs and protein to build up explosive power and muscle strength.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Mothers of stayer Umamusume add more carbs
to maintain endurance...)
choice_data_list: Every one of these boxed lunches looks great.
Every one of these boxed lunches looks great.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
However, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Training Club Dad
text_block_list.text: ‘Lacking attention to detail for athlete food’??

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
!
No, I mean—

text_block_list.name: Training Club Dad
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, Shi-chan, you can be honest.
We're doing this deliberately too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Dad
text_block_list.text: That's right. My girl successfully cut weight and won her race fair and square, so I packed a little reward for her.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Mom
text_block_list.text:
"She said she wanted glowing skin just like City-chan,
so I packed lots of side dishes that are great for your skin~♪"

text_block_list.name: Training Club Mom
text_block_list.text: It might stray from perfection, but wouldn't you rather they just enjoy eating it anyway?

text_block_list.name: Training Club Mom
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's just parental affection—wanting them
to eat good food, run lots, and grow up big and strong.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...A meal is meant to bring joy to others,
isn't it?
That's what everyone taught me long ago—

text_block_list.name: Training Club Mom
text_block_list.text: "Don't get down on yourself, don't get down. There are things only a parent can see, after all."

text_block_list.name: Training Club Dad
text_block_list.text: Right, right. If anything, isn't Shi-chan still at the age where she should be the one getting bentos made for her?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true at all!
I've grown bigger too, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I enrolled in Tracen Academy, and day after day,
working hand-in-hand with my Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Training Club Mom
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪
The two of you were working hard together earlier, after all.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Dad
text_block_list.text:
To think that Shi-chan, who used to be
so terrified of even holding a kitchen knife...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh!
Like I said...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surrounded and doted on by people of her parents' generation, Cesario looked more innocent than usual, appearing just like any girl her age.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It has gotten quite late, hasn't it? Thank you so much for today.
choice_data_list: I had a great time too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...If so, then I am glad.
choice_data_list: Plus, we got to see a rare side of Cesario.
We got to see your cute side, too, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Is it unusual?
choice_data_list: Usually, you're the one taking care of others, right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Perhaps because she's been my 'mentor' since childhood,
she always ends up fussing over me."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As inexperienced as I still am... in everyone's eyes,
I might still just be 'Shii-chan.'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...As an instructor guiding the next generation,
I need to do my best so they treat me as an equal!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
C-Cute, you say?
choice_data_list: Like a daughter when she's with her parents?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. That might be true.
Everyone dotes on me as if I were their own daughter.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However... as fellow guides for future runners,
I want them to see me as an equal soon.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes...! It might seem like nothing more than a child's endearing daydream right now, but someday, I know...!
